reason: $49 to $59 a month is a lot on my budget for something I haven't tried, and I'd only go for a Groupon or a free trial day. It also isn't open yet, so I'd just follow it on Instagram and wait.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? With ages 8 months to 5 all in one room I need to see how they keep the little ones safe before I pay anything.
would_change_my_mind: A free or heavily discounted first visit, like a Groupon or free trial day, and proof there is a separate or protected baby area.
